item.title: Cold notification issued Monday as temperatures to plummet
item.description: A cold notification has been issued by the Medical Officer of Health for the Grand Erie Public Health region. The notification – issued when temperatures are expected to dip below –15 C, or when wind chills reach –20 C – came into effect on Monday and will remain until a cancellation notice is issued.
